sql: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = 2023
raw_output: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = 2023;

sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) AS year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2026-01-01' AND order_date < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY year, month ORDER BY year, month
raw_output:
SELECT 
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) AS year,
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_date) AS month,
  COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM 
  orders
WHERE 
  order_date >= '2026-01-01' AND order_date < '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY 
  year, month
ORDER BY 
  year, month;

sql: SELECT s.supplier_id, s.supplier_name, COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_id) AS product_count FROM suppliers s LEFT JOIN products p ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id GROUP BY s.supplier_id, s.supplier_name
raw_output:
SELECT 
  s.supplier_id, 
  s.supplier_name, 
  COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_id) AS product_count
FROM 
  suppliers s
LEFT JOIN 
  products p ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id
GROUP BY 
  s.supplier_id, 
  s.supplier_name;

sql: SELECT c.category_id, c.category_name, p.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_units_sold FROM categories c JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name, p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY c.category_id, total_units_sold DESC
raw_output:
SELECT 
  c.category_id,
  c.category_name,
  p.product_id,
  p.product_name,
  SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_units_sold
FROM 
  categories c
JOIN 
  products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id
JOIN 
  order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY 
  c.category_id, c.category_name, p.product_id, p.product_name
ORDER BY 
  c.category_id, total_units_sold DESC;

sql: SELECT i.inventory_id, p.product_name, i.quantity_on_hand, i.reorder_level FROM inventory i JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id WHERE i.quantity_on_hand <= i.reorder_level
raw_output:
SELECT i.inventory_id, p.product_name, i.quantity_on_hand, i.reorder_level
FROM inventory i
JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE i.quantity_on_hand <= i.reorder_level;

sql: SELECT w.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name, SUM(i.quantity_on_hand * (SELECT AVG(price) FROM products p WHERE p.product_id = i.product_id)) AS total_value FROM inventory i JOIN warehouses w ON i.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id GROUP BY w.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name ORDER BY total_value DESC LIMIT 9
raw_output:
SELECT w.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name, SUM(i.quantity_on_hand * (SELECT AVG(price) FROM products p WHERE p.product_id = i.product_id)) AS total_value
FROM inventory i
JOIN warehouses w ON i.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
GROUP BY w.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name
ORDER BY total_value DESC
LIMIT 9;
